title: AZHOR
prompt: Create a crisp detailed pixel-art sprite animation sheet for Agents Bar, matching silver-blue, warm gold, deep navy medieval fantasy materials. TRUE frame-by-frame shapes changing, no merely translated or recolored copies. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, one animation per row, four successive frames left to right. Transparent alpha-zero background. No text, no labels, no frames, no checkerboard. Each cell has 15% empty padding on every edge; keep the whole effect inside its cell, with constant scale. Animate the EXACT four-legged city beast in the reference, facing LEFT, same architecture, halo, portal mouth, armor and curled tail. All cells same body scale. Row1 idle: relaxed, inhaling chest with mouth partly closing, head turns slightly, relaxed. Row2 heavy quadruped WALK: opposing legs contact, those legs passing flexed, opposite pair contact, opposite passing. Row3 JUMP: deep crouch, push upward rear legs extending, airborne all knees tucked, LAND with deeply bent legs and dust. Row4 HURT: brace, recoil head sideways and crouch, gather weight, stand recovered. Entire complete body newly drawn every frame; no cutouts. Feet baseline85% except airborne.
